meta.title: Support tunnel
meta.description: One reverse HTTPS tunnel brings every customer machine in behind a single inbound port: each kit holds one, and the Host opens its own loopback port per kit. The tunnel only gets you there — the work happens inside the customer's session: session1-agent handles desktop control, COM calls and arbitrary commands (127.0.0.1:9997), and modules under apps/ serve individual applications (SolidWorks, Excel, ...) on demand. ssh/scp remains the fallback path: it still works when the agent does not, and it carries large files. Includes kit listing, remote command execution with a dangerous-command guard, file transfer, audit log and forced disconnect.
